title: Helicopter Crash Recovery Operation New York City
description: On March 12, 2018, a drift collection vessel from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) participated in an operation to recover a downed helicopter that crashed into the East River on Sunday, March 11, 2018. The vessel known as the DRIFTMASTER used its crane to remove the helicopter from the East River, where it was secured to the East 23rd Street seaplane pier following the crash. Ricard P. Thorsen, chief, physical support branch, Caven Point Marine Terminal, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New York District, discusses the mission and the importance of agency partnerships with the New York City Police Department Harbor Unit, New York City Fire Department Marine Bureau, and the U.S. Coast Guard Sector, N.Y. (By: Hector Mosley, public affairs, USACE New York District)

transcript.text: The Driftmaster was called to come out into the East River and raise a sunken helicopter
that had gone down into East River last night.
And then once we got on scene, we basically worked with all of the agencies to basically
complete the coordination and the communication that's needed to perform the lift.
And then everything is basically taken in steps and safety again is paramount during every
step of the process.
Well the operation itself requires a lot of coordination with several agencies right
here in the city, the police department, the Coast Guard, the fire department, all those
agencies we work with because they all have a role here in the harbor.
And in an operation like this, the Coast Guard is responsible for making sure that the waterways
are basically safe and navigable.
We have a role in that and we have the equipment in order to keep the harbor clear.
We work very closely with the police department because they have the dive team that goes down
and actually rigs sunken objects such as helicopters and airplanes so that we can safely lift them
from the water.
The work is important in order to keep the harbor basically clear for navigation, to keep
it clear of any navigation obstructions which may be a problem for shipping in the way of
causing strikes, the vessels causing damage, pollution and possibly injury and loss of
life.
Thank our coordinating agencies here in the harbor for their cooperation and basically
for making this work so smoothly and so safely.

pass_reason: Recovery of a fatal helicopter crash wreck; no rescue.
